tips.li: Bossaps prisoners can be milked. What you do with this information is up to you.
An enraged bossaps will attack anyone who hurts them, even allies. In that situation my best advice is to run.
Docile slaves won't rebel unless their mood falls below the threshold for a minor mental break.
A blind, or blindfolded, character with the echolocation gene isn't affected by smoke when shooting.
Characters with the echolocation gene have a small chance to be born congenitally blind.
No soil? No problem. Dvergr can build fungal gravel underground, and brew the raw fungus grown there into alcohol.
In an emergency, Waterskip can create puddles to satisfy a nixie's need for wetness.
Characters with the Aquatic gene can build showers and use them to stay wet.
Nixies move faster than almost anything else in the water. You can use this to your advantage in combat.
Nixies' skin starts to dry out much faster when the temperature climbs above 31C/88F.
Nixies need at least 25 psyfocus to use their innate psycasts, which means time spent in meditation. If you're not using the psycasts you can set their desired psyfocus to 0%.
Nixies don't need a psylink to use their innate psycasts.
The insect pheromones gene will also protect colony animals.
A psylink won't trigger bio-rejection in trogs, but a mechlink will.
Trogs can make use of wild insects in multiple ways. You can try taming them, or just lure enemies close to a hive.
Warcats' raw meat requirement is cumulative over time. Fixing a deficiency requires making up for all the raw meat that was missed.
